To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the initiation of an electrical discharge in the bag cell neurosecretory neurons of Aplyisia is dependent upon calcium, and the initiation of this discharge is inhibited by agents that inhibit calcium-dependent enzymes.

the ability of electrical stimulation to trigger an electrical afterdischarge in peptidergigic neurons of Aplyisa is blocked by drugs that have been shown to inactivate several calcium-dependent enzymes.

1) trifluoperazine, W7 and calmidazilium inhibit the ability of stimulation of the bag cell neurons to generate an afterdischare; 2) trifluoperazne does not inhibit synaptic transmission, endogenous bursting or secretion; 3) trifluoperzine inhibits the initiation of an afterdischarge at a site which is distinct from that which controls the duration of the afterdischare.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the intracellular events that are responsible for the initiation of after-discharge.
the mechanisms by which neurons can change their excitability.
the mechanisms of neurosecretion in a neuroendocrine system in which a stimulus-induced change in electrical properties of the neurons triggers the secretion of neuroactive peptides.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the calcium dependent enzyme(s) are involved in the initiation and the maintenance of afterdischarge and the secretion of neurosecretory peptides in the bag cell neuron of Aplysias.

these agents inhibit the onset of the stimulus-induced transformation of the electrical properties of bag cell neuron and that this transformation is associated with an increased activity of a calcium-dependent enzyme.
the calcium-dependent enzymes are the key factors for the onset of after discharge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the calcium-dependent enzyme, protein kinase C, is involved in the onset of the electrical transformation in the bag cell neuron.
the bag cell neurons are a model for studying calcium-dependent enzymes in the nervous system.
the calcium-dependent enzyme is a protein kinase.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown that the ability of electrical stimulation to trigger afterdischarge in bag cell neurons is dependent upon the activity of a calcium-dependent enzyme.
the initiation of after-discharge in bag cell neurons is a calcium-dependent process.
the bag cells are a useful model system for studying the role of calcium-dependent enzymes in the control of neuronal excitability.
